review.posthog_relevance: Removes a feature flag and its associated conditional UI rendering, potentially permanently enabling or disabling the 'Logs' tab and settings button.
review.reason: The hunk P1.F3.H3 removes the conditional rendering of the 'Logs' tab and its settings button, while retaining the tabbed content itself. This indicates a permanent removal of the gating mechanism rather than a temporary rollout. This could affect users who were previously gated, potentially permanently enabling or disabling access to the Logs tab and its settings.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact on users and the broader context of why the flag was removed are not established by the code alone; this could be a minor cleanup or a significant behavior change. No tests or migration helpers are visible in this chunk.
